Gunslingers.name: Gunslingers
Gunslingers.summary: Professor Molina's train, the SteamBane, is rocketing through the canyons. The world's most powerful explosive is bolted to the engine. Only the four quickest guns in the West can stop them.

Racket Sports Party.name: Racquet Sports
Racket Sports Party.summary: For the first time, Racquet Sports serves up 5 of your favorite racquet games all in one. Players are immersed in stunning worldwide locations as they serve, rally and smash their way to the finals. Every family member can get into the action with easy-to-use controls that precisely simulate each player's movements. From Party Mode to Championship Mode, Racquet Sports is fun for everyone!

Rock Band 3.name: Rock Band 3
Rock Band 3.summary: Rock Band 3 adds 83 new songs to the Rock Band library and for the first time supports a keyboard/keytar peripheral.
